_doc: Prompts of the Face tab (hdart/puppet_face.py): racial hair and faces painted on the race's painted puppets. {style} = the paint style groups (specs/paint.json), {body} = the paint body text of the build painted on (race traits + description + gender body + its paint face & body words), {hair} / {face} = the race's description below (hair: the style only, no colour). Hair is painted in one key colour (`hair_key`, a colour nothing else on the character uses) and cut out by hue; its brightness becomes cel levels coloured by a hair ramp (Ramps, group hair). Hair: `hair.front`, then the back: `hair_back_edit` turns the painted front into a back view (keeps the hairstyle), its hair + a drawn cap guide a masked `hair.back` pass on the whole puppet. Face: `face` (front only; painted on the whole faceless puppet, framed like the Paint step's figure pass, from a drawn face guide); its irises are painted in `eye_key` (magenta) and coloured by an eye ramp (Ramps, group eyes).

hair.front: {style}. The head and shoulders of one {body}, now with {hair}. The hair is one flat vivid pure green colour (a green-screen colour key), shaded only with darker and lighter green, with clean dark outlines; the same face, head shape, ears, skin and body. Three-quarter view facing left, seen slightly from above, on a pure white background.
hair.back: {style}. The head and shoulders of the same {body} seen from behind, three-quarter back view, with {hair}: the same hairstyle as in the reference image, now from behind, in the same flat vivid pure green (a green-screen colour key), shaded only with darker and lighter green, with clean dark outlines, on a pure white background.

hair_back_edit: Show this exact character from behind: a three-quarter back view facing away to the right, seen slightly from above, the back of the head with no face visible, the same {hair} in the same flat vivid green colour key, shaded with darker and lighter green, clean dark outlines, the same size and position in the frame, plain white background.
face: {style}. One {body}, full body, three-quarter view facing left, seen slightly from above, standing in an A-pose, on a pure white background. Paint only the face, refining the face sketch into finished game art: {face}. The irises are one flat vivid magenta colour (a colour key), shaded only with darker and lighter magenta, with a dark pupil and a white highlight. The same head shape, skin colour, ears and lighting; clean dark outlines.

human.hair: shoulder length, shiny, bob cut, professional
human.face: large expressive eyes, big bushy eyebrows, a small nose, a small neutral mouth, anime eyes, anime face, kawaii, cute, highlights,
